outcome: Magnitude of failed induction of labor
Factors associated with failed induction of labor
cohort: Women who delivered at public hospitals in the Arsi zone, South East Ethiopia
finding: The study found a 21.3% rate of failed induction of labor, with significant associations found with maternal age, urban residence, being primiparous, a Bishop score of four, induction due to PROM or post-term pregnancy, and a delivery time under twelve hours.
